pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular, multi-angular polygonal regions with sharp pixel-level gradients at the edges. The margins are highly jagged, exhibiting 'cog-like' protrusions. Patch size is variable, with large, complex shapes on the mid-flank and smaller, more condensed geometries toward the hindquarters.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous topological graph of light-colored negative space. Junction nodes are primarily tri-radial. The pixel thickness of the pathways is non-uniform, narrowing between patch vertices and widening at multi-path intersections.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A low-amplitude, high-frequency sawtooth silhouette is visible along the neck and upper shoulder, created by the dense, upright follicles of the mane.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A single, thin, linear horizontal mark—consistent with a superficial scar—is visible bisecting a dark patch on the lower-central flank.
